text:
maya: Quick async standup — kernel perf & KV bench.
What I did: landed slot-transfer patch (reduces p95 ~6% on microburst bench).
Blockers: intermittent KV warmup variance on long tail, haven't nailed a repro across shards.
Today: run cross-shard soak + push tiny fallback in PR for slot-steal case, will also add a repro script.

jordan: nice. can you paste the bench command/config? want to run it locally :eyes:

maya: sure — bench command + flags I used:

```
./run_bench --profile=microburst --qps=10k --duration=20m --seed=42 --kv-prefetch=0.6
```

Also ran with `--slot-transfer=true` and the new kernel patch enabled.

infra-bot: CI run #7821 finished — unit tests: 124 passed, 3 flaky skipped. Perf artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/7821/artifacts :package:

sam: I pulled the artifact and replayed the bench. saw similar p95 improvement but evictions spike around 75s mark, correlated with slot handoff logs. attaching quick note.

maya: which instance type did you use? can you dump the flamegraph and a small slice of the logs?

sam: g5.2xlarge. flamegraph -> https://s3.redwood/perf/sam/slot-flame.svg. logs show repeated `evict_slot()` around t=75s. TL;DR prefetch threshold might be too aggressive for cold tails.

lee: quick ping on PR #409 — adds fallback path + emitted metrics. need review to start a canary.

zuri: tiny nit on metric naming in the PR — prefer `kv.evictions_total` vs `kv.slot_evictions` for Prometheus consistency.

lee: good catch, will rename. Can we also emit a `kv.evictions_reason{reason="slot_transfer"}` label? helps digging.

maya: agree on label. also want a short log line when fallback triggers so we can trace from perf logs -> metrics.

jordan: for the warmup variance, can we standardize a reproducible script? I can plug it into perf infra if it's deterministic.

maya: yes — I'm adding a `bench/repros/kv_warmup_repro.sh` to the branch. plan to push in ~2h. after that can we run a 6h soak across 4 shards?

sam: +1 to the soak. also adding a `grep` filter for evictions helps to isolate noise. example I used:

```
grep -E "evict_slot|slot_transfer|KV_PREFETCH" logs/*.log | tail -n 200
```

infra-bot: perf job #501 started by maya at 1702345730. target QPS=10000, duration=20m, shards=4. Artifacts will upload to https://ci.redwood/internal/501.

lee: FYI scheduled a quick sync at 16:00 UTC to go over the soak results and decide canary rollout. optional but helpful :calendar:

maya: I'll join. plan: merge PR after small rename + tests pass, then start 5% canary with burst to 15% if stable for 10m. config snippet for rollout:

```
{
  "canary": 0.05,
  "burst": 0.15,
  "stability_window": "10m",
  "metrics": ["p95_latency", "kv.evictions_total"]
}
```

zuri: also please add an alert if `kv.evictions_total` increases >200% over baseline in 5m window.

maya: will add that alert rule.

jordan: nothing else from me, thanks. :thumbsup:

maya: ok — will update thread after the soak and when PR landed. thanks all :rocket:
